## Why Choose Our Vegetarian Food Tour?

**14 Years of Dietary Expertise (Since 2011)**
We've accommodated every dietary need since 2011. Vegetarian, vegan, Jain, gluten-free — we know which stalls use belacan (shrimp paste), which use lard, which have dedicated allergen-free prep areas.

**100% Plant-Based Vendors**
No fish sauce. No shrimp paste. No oyster sauce. No surprises. Every vendor is verified for strict vegetarian standards. Buddhist vegetarian stalls (素食) exclude all animal products and the five pungent roots.

**Variety Beyond Salad**
Indian banana leaf rice, Buddhist mock meats, modern vegan cafes, traditional Nyonya vegetarian dishes. This is Malaysian cuisine at its most creative — not an afterthought.

**Small Groups (Max 9 People)**
Not "up to 15." Not "usually 12." Maximum 9 people, every tour. Because you can ask questions about ingredients. Because you can hear the vendor stories.
